1479-2841-8103-8338.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
1479-2841-8103-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-6159-8293.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
1479-2841-6159-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2023-4518-4785-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1874-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
1874-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

4823-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4823-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Timeless Witness and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
4823-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Timeless Witness and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2112-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
2112-6495-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1409-7839-7911.description:
Activate Gandalf by paying {1}{U}, blinking it
When Gandalf enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Gandalf.
Resolve the Gandalf trigger, dealing 3 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
1409-7839-7911.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, Gandalf's damage can be redirected to any desired target(s).

2999-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2999-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

5256-6461--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-7175.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-7175.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7379.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Zack Fair.
When Zack Fair dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

280-1558-2638-3129-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1558-2638-3129-4231.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1558-2557-2638-3861-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2557-2638-3861-4231.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

851-1651-3340-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Adrix and Nev.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4659-6835-6972.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

969-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
969-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

132-4896-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures that share a creature type.

5352-6991.notablePrerequisites: There are four permanents on the battlefield that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
5352-6991.description:
Cast Doppelgang by paying {15}{G}{U}, creating five token copies of Donnie & April and of the four mana-producing permanents.
When the Donnie & April tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Doppelgang and up to four other instant or sorcery cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seventeen of the mana-producing permanent tokens by tapping them, adding at least {15}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tokens and mana, you may instead target any other permanents using Doppelgang.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-6797-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-6797-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

1894-5220-5933-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

5220-5256-6481.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature whose power is 1 or greater.
5220-5256-6481.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature with power 1 or greater.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to the creature's power, ultimately milling the creature.
Colossal Grave-Reaver's second ability triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3490-3641-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-3490-3641-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Distinguished Conjurer indestructible.
2034-3490-3641-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

719-1429-1477-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-1477-5402.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

950-2085-4639.notablePrerequisites: Fatestitcher and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
950-2085-4639.description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Fatestitcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
Kelpie Guide triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4642-5455.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4642-5455.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

437-1383-4067.notablePrerequisites: You have exactly two cards in hand.
437-1383-4067.description:
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

251-1349-2034.notablePrerequisites: Denry Klin and another nontoken creature you control each have a coin counter on them.
251-1349-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrifiing another nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Athreos' third ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Denry Klin triggers, putting a coin counter on it.
Repeat.

147-2234.description:
Cast Baral's Expertise by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Baral's Expertise, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Baral's Expertise, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand, and casting Dualcaster Mage from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

2324-4050-4875-5170.notablePrerequisites: Any creature type besides "Dragon" chosen with Conspiracy.
2324-4050-4875-5170.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji, adding one mana of any color.
Junji dies, triggering itself and Proper Burial.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Junji's toughness.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

330-4508-5184.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander, and your commander is a Pirate.
You control at least one additional creature or artifact.
330-4508-5184.description:
Activate your commander by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
